note: Arizona's 7 no_catalog rows (6 campgrounds; Wild Cow Springs is listed twice). None added: every one is small, dispersed or behind a road the agency or reviewers say is wrong for trailers.

excluded.name: Wild Cow Springs Campground (Hualapai Mtns, BLM)
excluded.why: BLM: travel trailers over 20 ft and vehicles towing trailers not recommended beyond the Pine Lake firehouse; high-clearance 4WD highly recommended on the one-lane Flag Mine Road

excluded.name: Windy Point Campground (Cerbat Mtns, BLM)
excluded.why: BLM recommends against travel trailers on the unpaved Big Wash Road; high clearance recommended

excluded.name: Lockett Meadow Campground (Coconino NF)
excluded.why: FR 552 is steep, narrow, single-lane and rough beside a cliff; trailers strongly discouraged

excluded.name: Honeymoon Campground (Apache-Sitgreaves NF)
excluded.why: 4 sites at the end of 20+ miles of dirt with creek crossings; reviewers say large RVs would find it difficult or impossible and high clearance/4WD is advisable in wet seasons

excluded.name: Brown Creek (Apache-Sitgreaves NF)
excluded.why: undeveloped dispersed area with no facilities; best for tents or pop-ups

excluded.name: Promontory Pit Road Campground (Rim Lakes)
excluded.why: unimproved designated dispersed sites; trailers of 21 ft or less on sites 2 and 3 only
